Context: This update covers Ethnic Wear revenue, June versus May. Revenue was INR 185107.61 in May and INR 76371.53 in June.
Insight (fact): Ethnic Wear revenue changed by -58.74% month on month, an overall decline.
Implication (hypothesis, not proven by this data alone): the movement may reflect a change in reseller activity or product mix. Recommended next step: check whether resellers reduced their Ethnic Wear listings or whether Ethnic Wear demand fell, and compare order counts and return rates for Ethnic Wear between May and June.
